text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Hishi 
Amazon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainy, got a minute after this? Mind 
giving me a hand?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to pick a one-on-one fight 
or anything! I just have two tickets to an 
art museum.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I got it from a shop I frequent in 
the shopping district. Even though I told 
'em it really wasn't my style.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Someone's giving you something out of 
kindness, so rejecting it so stubbornly 
would just be rude, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Figured you might know more about the 
arts than I do, Trainy."

I'm not particularly knowledgeable about 
art, but since we had the chance, I 
decided to visit the art museum with her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... It's pretty spacious, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, check it out, Trainy. There's a statue 
of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The title is "Sprinting Umamusume"... 
Indeed, it looks like it could dash 
forward at any second!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Look at this human sculpture over here 
too! It's so muscular, it looks like it 
could start moving at any second.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Makes you wanna challenge 'em to a 
one-on-one, doesn't it? Whoever made this 
is incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No ordinary observation skills or 
craftsmanship could pull this off. Truly, 
it's magnificent.

Together with Hishi Amazon, who was 
constantly filled with admiration, we took 
our time touring the art museum.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, paintings, installations... Every 
single piece was so powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get all the complicated 
stuff, but I totally vibe with how 
passionate those artists are!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Trainy. If I were on my 
own, I might've just dismissed it without 
even trying.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you coming along, it was a 
really great experience!
choice_data_list:
Let's run worthy of being an artist's 
model!
Let's experience all sorts of new things

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Me, a model for a work of art...? Huh, I 
never would've thought of that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's show off this burning 
passion I felt through my running this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That's just my way of responding to an 
artist!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And if someone sees me run and gets 
inspired to make another awesome piece, 
that'd be the best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, no time to dilly-dally! Let's 
head back quick and start training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainee! First, we jog back to 
the academy!

Watching Hishi Amazon's back as she ran 
off, a new dream took shape in both of our 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's true. It really showed me how much 
you can gain from racking up all sorts of 
experiences.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I might not be good at studying, but I'm 
confident in feeling with my heart and 
learning through all five senses!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Doesn't it smell nice coming from over 
there? Let's trust our noses and check it 
out!

I went to a museum cafe together with 
Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ho, a tall stack of pancakes drizzled with 
chocolate in patterns of museum paintings, 
is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It gave me great ideas for the dorm 
students' snacks and bento boxes. See, it 
really pays to try out everything once.
choice_data_list:
You were always good at making character 
bentos, weren't you?

You were always good at making character 
bentos, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, to thank you for today, I'll make 
you a bento sometime, Train-dog.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even a bento is a work of art made with 
love. I guarantee it'll taste great!
